shared_elements: rows of small repeated elements (crew strokes in A, repeated small carved signs on the figure in B)
justification:
Both surfaces carry schematic, reductive carved imagery including short rows of repeated small marks, but that is where the correspondence ends. A depicts several profile boats with crew strokes floating free on an open field, while B depicts a single massive frontal anthropomorphic figure with a head, torso and applied relief motifs such as rings and curved bands 
inone of A's subject matter appears in B and vice versa.
